title: New tier for requiring root
description: We have received repeated feedback from support that they'd like us to start labeling Workbench CLI command by whether or not it requires root (the errors do indicate that something requires root but it would be good for the user to know ahead of time vs. trial and error). Instead of using HTML / a bootstrap icon, we are adding it as a "tier" so it can be easily circulated and used (in a standardized way) across teams, if they choose. To use the icon, simply: `{{< tier shield >}} Closes #15

title: support title and url in YAML and shortcode
description:
~Note: Hold on merging; want to tag the existing code before landing this change.~

This change proposes versioning the extension as 2.0.0, as it is a major change from what came before.

* style badges wiith <a> when a URL is given
* add title= when a title is given
* use rounded-pill rather than including border-radius, as it handles arbitrary sizes
* remove unused badge-default and badge-target classes
* remove commented-out styles
* add <a> and a:hover styles
* add no-external to avoid external-link icon
* do not condition tier styling on quarto-tiers configuration; no configuration is necessary by default

fixes #2

title: Updating Badge styles, reorg, fixing "misc" badge
